auditor_value: f_max = μ m_A g = 10 N; together a = t/3 until 4t/3 = 10 ⇒ t = 7.5 s (a = 2.5 m/s²); after that a_B = 10/4 = 2.5 m/s² constant, a_A = (2t − 10)/2 = t − 5 (continuous at t = 7.5 s)

findings.quote: rising from 2.5 m/s² and pulling ahead of a_B
findings.note: 'Pulling ahead' is an idiom; the served answer should state the relation literally.
findings.fix: For t > 7.5 s, a_B stays constant at 2.5 m/s², while a_A = t − 5 rises from 2.5 m/s² with slope 1 m/s² per second and is greater than a_B.

notes: Independent solve agrees on the slip time, both branches and the continuity at t = 7.5 s. common_mistakes[1] computes as stated (f_max = 30 N ⇒ 4t/3 = 30 ⇒ t = 22.5 s).
